narrative.en: The deal is done, and a new hand begins on block 25455400. A Uniswap V4 pool with hooks is not just another liquidity pair—it's a bid for new mechanics. The pair: native ETH against contract 0x63ee...c0c0. And here's the kicker: that same address serves as the hooks. A closed loop—the contract services itself, audits itself. The fee of 8388608 is no mistake. In V4, that code means a dynamic or custom fee structure, not the standard 0.01%, 0.05%, or 0.30%. It's manual tuning, hinting at non-standard logic. Tick spacing 200—the step between ticks is wide, so the pool is built for volatile pairs or large orders where precision doesn't matter, but less gas on crossing. But the real card is the hooks contract itself. It is the token, it is the manager. That means every swap, every added or removed liquidity, passes through its filters. Whoever controls that contract controls the flow. And pool ID 0x9450...991—now a marker on the blockchain worth watching. No conclusions—only the fact: a new hand is on the felt. And its suit is yet unknown.
narrative.zh: 新的一局在区块 25455400 开启。Uniswap V4 带钩子的池子，不是普通的流动性——它是在争夺新的门派心法。对子：原生 ETH 对阵合约 0x63ee...c0c0。有意思的是，同一个地址就是钩子本身。自成一统——合约自己服务自己，自己审核自己。手续费 8388608 不是笔误。在 V4 里，这个代码代表动态或自定义收费结构，不是标准的 0.01%、0.05% 或 0.30%。这是手动调校，暗示着非常规的机关。Tick 间距 200——步宽大，说明这池子是为波动大的对子或大单准备的，精度不重要，但省 gas。真正的王牌是这个钩子合约。它既是代币，又是掌门。每一笔交换、每一次增减流动性，都得过它的关口。谁控制这合约，谁就控制了水流。池子 ID 0x9450...991——链上又多了一个值得留意的标记。不下定论——只摆事实：桌上多了一手新牌。花色未明。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees—either zero or the maximum tier—instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap.
take.zh: 建设者们正在部署使用非标准 swap 费用的池子——要么是零，要么是最高档——而不是常见的市场费率。这表明了刻意的经济设计：收入通过钩子而非 swap 本身收取。

narrative.en: The deal keeps coming, and tonight the deck is stacked with thirteen fresh pools in a single day. Thirteen. Nearly all of them take ETH at the door. One hook contract appears in four consecutive pools, three tokens minted in a single block. It's a production line, not a launch. Tick spacing at 200, fee at zero — no cushion against volatility, pure speculation dressed as liquidity. Another hook runs two pools with the maximum fee tier but a tight tick spacing of 60. Someone wants to catch every price tick and charge top dollar for it. And then there's the pool with fee 100 and tick spacing 1 — a gas guzzler for those who fear no transaction cost. Precision at any price. Meanwhile, the GitHub is silent except for two NatSpec typo fixes from 0xAxiom. Someone reads the fine print while the house deals from the bottom. The hooks are the new jokers, but who's shuffling and why remains unseen. Only the stakes feel higher.
narrative.zh: 江湖又起波澜。今日十三池齐开，十三。几乎都以ETH为入门之资。一个钩子合约连现四池，同一区块内连铸三枚代币——这不是开池，是流水线。tick间距二百，手续费为零，毫无波动缓冲，纯是投机披着流动性的皮。另一钩子双池皆取最高费率，却配六十的细密tick间距——要捕尽每一丝价差，且收最重的过路钱。更有费率一百、tick间距一的池子，那是烧着gas买精准，只为某种不容偏差的暗器。GitHub上却静默如夜，唯0xAxiom修了两处NatSpec错字。有人细读秘籍，有人暗布棋局。钩子便是新式暗器，但执棋之手与落子之意，仍隐于迷雾。只觉内力暗涌，赌注已悄然加码。

take.en: Thirteen pools in a day, all with non-standard fee structures: either zero or maximum tier, signaling deliberate economic design through the hook, not organic token launches.
take.zh: 今日十三池齐发，皆用非常规费率——零费或最高档，明示收入仰仗钩子而非交易，绝非寻常开池之举。

narrative.en: The night's surveillance turned up a cluster. Eight V4 hook pools in a single day, and this isn't just a routine airdrop — someone is laying out a solitaire. Four pools with zero fee and tickSpacing 200, all through the same hook contract — 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc. Same suit: ETH against four different tokens. Blocks 25440724-25440741 — the interval under a minute. Someone deployed them in a series, like an automaton. Four tokens, four pools, one template. Then two pools with a 100 fee and tickSpacing 1. Also ETH pairs, but different hooks — 0x3b9136df571f9e10f8b30d777658b32a17e04144 and 0x954d9a5b5613722f3d1e2f29b7bebf02526e0144. These were spaced a bit wider in time, but the logic is the same — standard settings, no exotic parameters. Separately, a USDT pool — 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. Fee 8388608, tickSpacing 10, hook 0xfffff5962193fbdc458e81cac67437e426c708c0. That's no ordinary deal. 8388608 is a nonstandard fee, nearly at the boundary of what's allowed. And a hook with that address — not random. The last pool, token 0xcfcc25e924bc022735e1e4c79a5cc6ded2f42c72 — again fee 100 and tickSpacing 1, but a different hook. Eight pools. Three different hooks. One cluster of zero-fee pools. One anomalous USDT. Looking at the deck, someone is clearly testing strategies on V4, and not alone. Four pools through one hook — that's a bot or a script. The USDT pool — either an experiment with fee tiers, or preparation for something more complex. The night showed: the V4 hook ecosystem is gaining momentum, and not every player here is for liquidity.
narrative.zh: 夜巡，发现一个集群。一天之内八个V4钩子池，这不是普通的撒币——有人分明在摆一局大棋。四个零费率池，tick间距200，全走同一个钩子合约——0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc。清一色ETH对四个不同代币。区块25440724到25440741，间隔不到一分钟。有人像机关枪一样连续部署，四个代币，四个池子，一个模子。接着两个费率100、tick间距1的池子，也是ETH对，但钩子不同：0x3b9136df571f9e10f8b30d777658b32a17e04144和0x954d9a5b5613722f3d1e2f29b7bebf02526e0144。时间上拉开了一些，但逻辑一样——标准设置，没有花哨参数。还有一个USDT池——0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7。费率8388608，tick间距10，钩子0xfffff5962193fbdc458e81cac67437e426c708c0。这可不是寻常买卖。8388608是非标准费率，几乎顶到上限。那个钩子地址——绝非偶然。最后一个池子，代币0xcfcc25e924bc022735e1e4c79a5cc6ded2f42c72——又是费率100、tick间距1，但钩子又换了。八个池子，三个不同钩子，一个零费率集群，一个异常USDT。看这牌面，有人在V4上试策略，而且不是单枪匹马。四个池子用一个钩子——那是脚本或机器人。USDT池——要么是费率实验，要么是更大布局的前奏。这一夜说明：V4钩子江湖正在风起，而来者并非都为流动性。

take.en: The dealer is stacking the deck: eight pools in a day, half with zero fees, one at the maximum tier — this isn't random play, it's a deliberate pattern.
take.zh: 庄家在洗牌：一天八个池，半数零费率，一个顶格费率——这不是随机落子，而是刻意布局。

narrative.en: The deck's been shuffled again, and seven fresh pools just hit the felt on the same blockchain. Every pair uses ETH as the base asset — no stablecoins, no memecoins, just pure volatility. The hooks are all different, each a distinct card in the dealer's sleeve. Two pools appeared almost back-to-back: one with zero commission and a wide tick step for the heavy hitters who don't need constant recalculations, the other with a high commission and tight step for those who like it dense. Then came three more in quick succession, all with the same high commission and tight step, but different tokens. Only one more zero-commission, wide-step pool surfaced. The seventh arrived later, again high commission and tight step. Seven deals in an hour, no two hook schemes alike. Someone is testing strategies — dynamic fees, oracles, who knows what. Each hook contract is a card face-down, and I won't know its suit until it's flipped.
narrative.zh: 今夜又无眠，但牌局已重新洗过。同一链上，七口V4池子，七种钩子，每口都不同。所有池子都以ETH为底——没有稳定币，没有土狗币，纯粹波动。前两口几乎同时落地，一池零费率、宽步距，给大户准备，不需频繁计算；另一池高费率、窄步距，适合喜欢密集交易的人。接着三池接连而至，都是高费率、窄步距，但代币不同。只有一口是零费率、宽步距。第七口姗姗来迟，仍是高费率、窄步距。一个时辰七局，钩子无一重复。有人在试各种策略：动态费率、预言机，天知道还有什么。每张钩子合约都是扣着的牌，不翻面不知花色。

take.en: Seven pools, all ETH-based, all with non-standard fees — someone is building a system, not launching a token.
take.zh: 七口池，全用ETH，全是非常规费率——这是有人在搭台，不是发币。

narrative.en: The night dealt five new pools in rapid succession, each one a fresh card from a newly opened deck. Five initializations across a handful of blocks — this isn't noise, it's a rhythm. The first pair, native ETH against a contract, carries zero swap fee and a wide tick spacing. Someone isn't planning to earn from swaps; this pool is an infrastructure layer. The hook is fresh, unmarked, without history. Next comes another: different tokens, a maximum fee tier and tight tick spacing — built for volatility. Another clean hook. Then three pools in a row, all with ETH, all with a moderate fee and tight spacing, but each with a different contract and a different hook, none repeated. What catches the eye: not a single pool uses a known, battle-tested hook. Every contract is new, with no trace of prior deployments. This isn't random testing. Someone is laying out a whole network of specialized pools, each with its own hook, each tuned to its own logic. Zero fee on one, maximum on another — the spectrum is wide. ETH is the base in every case. It looks like the assembly of infrastructure for some scenario where hooks do all the work and fees are just a tuning parameter. The night was quiet, but the deck is being shuffled. The only question left: who's dealing?
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖暗流涌动，五个新池子接连出世，如同赌桌上刚开封的牌。第一对，原生ETH配一个陌生合约，零手续费，价差间距极宽。这人显然不靠兑换赚钱，池子只是他的内力根基。钩子崭新，无门无派，没有过往。紧接着第二池：不同令牌，万分之一手续费，极窄价差——专为暴烈波动而设。又一个无名钩子。再连三池，皆以ETH为基，手续费中等，价差紧凑，但每池合约不同，钩子各异，无一重复。蹊跷的是，没有一个池子用了江湖上成名已久的钩子。所有合约都是新面孔，从未在过往交易中现身。这不是随性试招，而是有人在布阵——一张由专属钩子驱动的池子网络，每池一套心法，各司其职。零费与天价费并存，ETH始终是根基。这不像散兵游勇的试探，更像在搭建一套完整的武学体系：钩子承载全部招式，手续费不过是调节内息。夜虽静，牌已洗。只待看谁落座发牌。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees — either zero or the maximum tier — instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap.
take.zh: 有人在部署手续费非标——要么零费，要么最高档——而非市价中档的池子。这不是偶然，是刻意布局：收益不走兑换，而是通过钩子抽取。

narrative.en: The deal came in clusters tonight. Eleven pools across a handful of blocks — not noise, but a pattern. Most pairs anchor to WETH, fee tier 100, tick spacing 1 — the standard layout for high-frequency play. But the outliers tell the real story. Three pools at blocks 25419128–25419133 share hook contracts ending in 144, a deliberate line of deployment. Two zero-fee pools at 25419427 and 25419532 use hooks identical to the second token's address — the hook is the token, the token is the hook. That's not an experiment; that's architecture. One pool with fee 10000 and wide tick spacing at block 25419167 suggests a different game: wide spreads for volatile pairs, or something else entirely. All but one use WETH as the base asset — Ethereum remains the anchor of liquidity even on V4. Hooks are a new suit in the deck, and tonight they were dealt in volume. Someone is building a hand. Someone is testing a new tactic. Someone is just building. The deck is shuffled. Watch where the cards fall.
narrative.zh: 今夜江湖暗流涌动。十一个池子接连现身，不是散兵游勇，而是一套阵法。多数池子以WETH为基，费率百一，间距为一——这是高频门派的标配。但真正的玄机在异数。三个池子（块25419128至25419133）共享同一套钩子合约，尾号144，分明是有人布下一条线。两个零费率池子（块25419427、25419532）的钩子地址与第二币种相同——钩即是币，币即是钩。这不是试招，这是立派。还有一个池子费率万、间距二百（块25419167），那是为烈性币种准备的宽门。所有池子几乎都以WETH为基——以太坊仍是江湖的镇海神针。钩子是新的兵器，今夜有人批量亮剑。有人在组牌局，有人在试新招，有人只是在建。牌已洗过，看它如何落定。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees — either zero or the maximum tier — instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue flows through the hook, not the swap.
take.zh: 江湖客在部署非常规费率的池子——要么零费率，要么最高档，而非市价费率——这意味着收入通过钩子而非交换来收取，是刻意的经济设计。

narrative.en: Six fresh v4 pools, all spawned within a single block range. Three of them share the same hook contract — 0x96b893. That's not coincidence; that's a pattern. Fee=0, tickSpacing=200 — these parameters aren't for casual trading. Someone is stacking liquidity in specific zones, likely for a strategy involving dynamic fees or oracles. The hook contract is the key. If it's controlled, the owner can change logic after the fact. This is either an experiment or preparation for something more complex. The other three pools carry fee=100 and tickSpacing=1 — classics for memes or low-liquidity pairs. Each with its own unique hook: 0xd62b5a, 0xe6b43b, 0x6e7b24 — different hands, different intentions. TickSpacing=1 means orders can be placed on every tick, a rarity. Usually used for high-volatility pairs or bots wanting pinpoint range capture. WETH is the constant; the tokens are unfamiliar. None appear in top listings. These pools are built for specific tasks — testnet migrations, fresh mints, hidden allocations. The block span from 25411905 to 25412713 covers roughly 800 blocks, about 2.5 to 3 hours. Someone spent time deploying six pools with varied configs. Not a spontaneous move. The observer should remember address 0x96b893. If that hook starts interacting with other protocols or changing state, it will be a signal. For now, silence. But the deck has been dealt.
narrative.zh: 六个新池子，同一段区块区间内诞生。其中三个共用一个 hook 合约，0x96b893。这不是巧合，这是路数。手续费为零，tick 间距 200——这些参数不是给随便交易用的。有人在特定区域布下流动性，可能是为动态费率或预言机策略做准备。那个 hook 合约是关键。如果它是可控制的，主人事后能改逻辑。这不是实验，就是更复杂局面的前奏。另外三个池子，手续费 100，tick 间距 1——江湖上 meme 币或低流动性对子的老套路。每个池子有自己的独门 hook：0xd62b5a、0xe6b43b、0x6e7b24——不同的人，不同的算盘。tick 间距为 1，意味着每个 tick 上都能挂单，少见。通常用于高波动的对子，或者那些想精准卡位的机器人。WETH 是铁打的营盘，代币都是生面孔。没有一个在主流榜单上。这些池子是为特定任务造的——测试网迁移、新鲜铸造、暗仓分配。区块跨度从 25411905 到 25412713，大约 800 个区块，两三个时辰的功夫。有人花时间部署了六个配置各异的池子。不是心血来潮。看客该记住 0x96b893 这个地址。如果这个 hook 开始与其他门派互动或改变状态，那就是信号。眼下风平浪静。但牌已发下。

take.en: The deal is on the felt: three pools with the same hook and zero fees signal a deliberate strategy, not random noise.
take.zh: 牌已发下：三个同 hook 的零费率池子，不是闲棋，是杀招。

narrative.en: The deal is cut. Thirteen fresh pools on the Uniswap V4 felt today, but the cards are marked. Three zero-fee pools landed in block 25405340, tick spacing 200, paired with odd tokens against WETH. The hooks are different, but the intent is the same: someone is testing how the market behaves when the house takes nothing at the door. Then, a tight-spread pool with fee 100 and tick spacing 1 appears in block 25405522 — a sniper's setup, controlling every tick. But the real play is the seven-pool series, all fee 3000, tick spacing 60, same hook, all against USDC. That's a network, not a lottery. And then the joker: a pool in block 25404703 with fee 8388608 — eight million basis points — against WETH. That's not a fee, it's a flag. The hook is the real game. These aren't organic launches; they're engineered plays. Builders are taking their revenue through the hook, not the swap. Watch the pattern, not the noise.
narrative.zh: 江湖上今天又多了十三座新寨子，全是Uniswap V4的门派。头三座在区块25405340立起来，香火钱分文不取，tick间距200，配的都是些生面孔的令牌，跟WETH搭伙。两个寨主用的钩子不同，但心思一样——想看看不收过路费，这江湖怎么走。接着，区块25405522冒出一座窄门，手续费100，tick间距1，像一把暗器，专盯每一个点位。真正的大手笔在后面：七座寨子，手续费都是3000，tick间距60，同一种钩子，全对着USDC。这不是散兵游勇，是有人在布阵。最邪门的是区块25404703那一座——手续费8388608，八百万个基点，对WETH。这不是收钱，是立旗。钩子里藏着真功夫。这些不是新芽出土，是有人故意挖坑。内力不从过路费里取，全藏在钩子里。江湖路远，看招不看出身。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees — either zero or the maximum tier — instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design through the hook, not an organic token launch.
take.zh: 有人在布阵：池子的手续费要么挂零，要么顶格，不走寻常路——内力不从过路费里取，全藏在钩子里。这不是新芽出土，是有人故意挖坑。

narrative.en: The deal's already in motion before you even sit down. Eight fresh Uniswap V4 pools dropped inside an hour, and if you think that's random, you haven't looked at the hook contracts. One hook — 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc — appears in four pools. All zero swap fees, all with the same tight tick spacing, all paired with tokens that smell like fresh mints. Four names, one operator, one strategy. Someone is stamping liquidity under the same hook, and this is no casual farmer.
narrative.zh: 夜深了，牌局却刚刚开始。一个时辰之内，Uniswap V4 上冒出了八个新池子。你要是觉得这是巧合，那就没看那钩子合约。同一个钩子——0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc——出现在四个池子里。全零手续费，同样的窄间距，配的都是刚出炉的代币。四个名号，一个操盘手，一套路数。有人在用同一把钩子批量铸造流动性，这不是散户干的事。

take.en: The house is stacking identical hooks across multiple pools — this isn't noise, it's a pattern.
take.zh: 同一个钩子，四个池子——这不是散兵游勇，这是有备而来。

narrative.en: The night was quiet, but the deck dealt its cards anyway. Five new V4 pools on Uniswap, all in a single block — 25391128 — and these aren't just numbers. Two of them launched simultaneously, sharing the same WETH but paired with different tokens and built with opposing architectures. The first pairs WETH with USDT, using a minimal swap fee and the tightest price step — a classic stable pair. Its hook contract watches liquidity breathe. The second pairs WETH with an unknown token, but charges the maximum possible swap fee — near 84 basis points. That's not a mistake. That's a signal: either high volatility is expected, or retail liquidity providers are being deliberately shut out. A third pool appears one block later, again with a minimal fee and tight spread, same WETH, another unknown token. Then a standard mid-volatility pool with a 0.3% fee. And finally a USDC/USDT stable pair with the tightest spread. Every single one uses hooks. Not a single bare V4 pool. Two pools with the same WETH but wildly different fees — like two hands playing against the same deck. No big names among the tokens. Only USDT, USDC, and three unknown contracts. Who launched them is invisible. But they know exactly what they're doing. Especially the one who set that near-84-basis-point fee. He's either expecting a storm, or he's about to make one.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖风平浪静，但牌局依然在发牌。Uniswap V4 在一夜之间连开五座新池，其中两座几乎同时诞生，共享同一个 WETH，却配了不同的对手和截然不同的内力架构。第一座池子，WETH 对 USDT，手续费极低，价格步长最窄——这是稳定币对的标准打法。它的钩子合约像一位隐士，静静观察着流动性的呼吸。第二座池子，WETH 对一枚无名代币，手续费却拉到了最高——接近八十四基点。这不是失误。这是明牌：要么预期风浪将至，要么故意将散户做市商挡在门外。第三座池子紧随其后，同样是低手续费、窄步长，WETH 对另一枚无名币。然后是标准的中等波动池，手续费千分之三。最后是一座 USDC/USDT 稳定币池，窄步长。所有池子都装了钩子，没有一座是裸奔的 V4。两座池子用同一个 WETH，手续费却天差地别——就像两只手在跟同一副牌。代币里没有大派名号，只有 USDT、USDC 和三枚不知底细的合约。谁布的局，看不穿。但他们显然知道自己在做什么。尤其是那个设了最高手续费的人——他要么在等一场风暴，要么自己就是风暴。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with deliberately non-standard swap fees — either the minimum or the maximum — signaling that revenue is extracted through the hook, not the swap, and that these are engineered economic experiments, not organic token launches.
take.zh: 建造者们正在部署手续费极低或极高的池子，而非市场常规费率——这意味着收入通过钩子而非交换来抽取，这些是精心设计的经济实验，而非自然的代币发行。

narrative.en: The table's been set, and the cards are no accident. Fourteen fresh V4 hook pools in a single day, each with its own signature. First wave: three pools sharing one hook contract, same ETH base, three different tokens. Fee at 100, tick spacing at 1 — a scalper's delight, micro-stepping through the spread. Then the twist: a pool where the token address and the hook address are one and the same. Fee maxed at 8388608, spacing 60. This isn't a bug; it's a private club, a closed-loop design where the hook is its own token. Next, six zero-fee pools in a row, three different hooks, spacings of 60 or 200. Zero fees on V4 with hooks isn't charity — it's a data play, an oracle strategy, a prelude to something that only reveals itself after the first swap. And then the clincher: three pools on the same pair, same hook, but three different parameter sets — 50000/1000, 50100/1002, 49900/998. A deliberate offset of 100 basis points and 2 ticks. Real-time A/B testing on the felt. Finally, a max-fee pool on ETH/TokenX, followed immediately by another pool linking that same token to a second token, all under the same hook. Two pools, one hook — a bridge, not just liquidity. The deck is stacked. Someone is setting up for a move.
narrative.zh: 江湖上风起云涌，一天之内冒出十四个V4钩子池，每个都带着自己的路数。头三个池子共用同一个钩子合约，ETH打底，配三个不同的令牌，手续费定在100，tick间距1——这是给短线快手准备的微操工具。接着来了个狠角色：池子的令牌地址和钩子合约地址一模一样，手续费拉到顶8388608，间距60。这不是bug，是故意设的局——钩子自己就是令牌，一个封闭的圈子。再往后，连续六个零手续费的池子，三个不同的钩子，间距60或200。零费率不是做慈善，是在布阵——要么是喂价，要么是收数据，要么是等第一笔交易后才亮出底牌。最绝的是：同一个交易对，同一个钩子，三个不同的参数——50000/1000，50100/1002，49900/998。偏移100个基点，差2个tick间距。这是当着全江湖的面做测试，A/B对比，毫不遮掩。最后，一个最高手续费的池子，ETH对某个令牌，紧接着又一个池子，同一个钩子，把那个令牌和另一个令牌连起来。两个池子，一个钩子——这不是流动性，是桥。牌局已经码好，有人在等时机。

take.en: The hand is not random: fourteen pools, each parameter tweaked with surgical intent — zero fees for data, max fees for exclusivity, and a triple calibration test — all pointing to a coordinated strategy, not a scatter of liquidity.
take.zh: 十四个池子，参数各有玄机——零费率是布阵，最高费率是关门，三重校准是亮剑——这不是散兵游勇，是有人在下一盘大棋。

narrative.en: The deal hits the felt again. Ten new V4 hook pools in a single day, and if you think that's just blockchain noise, you've already folded. Most are paired with ETH — standard play — but the real tell is the hook contracts. Four pools share the same hook address: 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc. That address laid down three pools with tokens 0x631aa4f8d097fe71ff44892f929d513019d0a62d, 0x1c60350d6efb580fa30d7f5714834c961e14ac6a, and 0x7eaa630332a02baf70e3ec4ad24b9f101f662b50 — all with zero swap fee. This isn't about trading; it's about something else. The hook is running its own logic, independent of the swap fee. Zero fee with a wide liquidity funnel — no LP sits there for yield. Another pattern: pools with fee set to 8388608. That's not a standard fee — it's a flag in hex, 0x800000. The hook uses a bitmask for custom fee math or distribution. Two such pools: one with token 0x1c66cb13b9a33b5e9c4f62a82ea9ae6ac62fa0cc — and note, the hook contract is the same as the token. Self-hook, the contract calls itself. The second with token 0xa4e2af01f1c06fcb46f88aa90fb226086258bb8c and hook 0x37343de810954364944ce92935cbb8f4c67100cc. And one more: a WETH pool with token 0x00000000c8e2db16f28bb8c89e5cea85ff266836, standard fee 3000, standard tick spacing 60. But the hook contract is 0xf455785a5fb80cd22078c47ac98193b0. The house is stacking the deck with custom hooks, not standard liquidity.
narrative.zh: 牌局又开了一轮。一天之内，十个新的 V4 hook 池子落地。如果觉得这只是链上技术标记，那你已经输了。多数池子对的是 ETH——常规打法——但真正的门道在 hook 合约里。四个池子共用同一个 hook 地址：0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc。这个地址布下了三个池子，代币分别是 0x631aa4f8d097fe71ff44892f929d513019d0a62d、0x1c60350d6efb580fa30d7f5714834c961e14ac6a 和 0x7eaa630332a02baf70e3ec4ad24b9f101f662b50——全部零手续费。这不是为了交易，是为了别的东西。hook 在运行自己的逻辑，跟交易费无关。零手续费加宽流动性漏斗——没有 LP 会为了收益坐在这里。另一个模式：手续费设为 8388608 的池子。这不是标准费率——十六进制是 0x800000，一个标志位。hook 用位掩码实现自定义费用计算或分配。两个这样的池子：一个代币是 0x1c66cb13b9a33b5e9c4f62a82ea9ae6ac62fa0cc——注意，hook 合约和代币是同一个地址。自 hook，合约调用自己。另一个代币 0xa4e2af01f1c06fcb46f88aa90fb226086258bb8c，hook 是 0x37343de810954364944ce92935cbb8f4c67100cc。还有一个 WETH 池子，代币 0x00000000c8e2db16f28bb8c89e5cea85ff266836，标准费率 3000，标准 tick 间距 60。但 hook 合约是 0xf455785a5fb80cd22078c47ac98193b0。庄家在牌里做了手脚，用的不是标准流动性，而是自定义 hook。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees — either zero or the maximum tier — instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap, not an organic token launch.
take.zh: 建造者正在部署非标准手续费的池子——要么零费率，要么最高档——而不是常见的市场费率。这说明经济设计别有用心：收入通过 hook 而非交易收取，不是自然的代币发行。

narrative.en: Two decks on the felt. One stack holds zeros. The other holds an address that is both hook and token in a single hand. Pool ID 0x594e8b83eb1ff6ffada65542d3881bd2aafbf89f28ccbeba1d8ab04dae97b1e4 fixed itself on block 25369082. You look at the fee tier 3000 and tickSpacing 60 — standard cut for pairs where volatility hasn't yet turned to noise. But the hooks contract matches one of the tokens. That's not a bug. It's a declaration: the contract decides for itself when and how to shuffle liquidity. No one asked permission. V4 pools don't knock on the door — they just appear. And this particular hook is written so its logic is inseparable from the token. If anyone wants to pull liquidity, they'll have to talk to their own mirror. The night is quiet. No alarms in the mempool. No one flash-loaned to probe the edges. Just someone laid out the deck and left it on the table. Maybe a test. Maybe the first move in a game where zeros and addresses have swapped roles. Watch that pool ID. It doesn't shout. It waits for someone else to make the first move.
narrative.zh: 两副牌摊在桌上。一叠是零，另一叠是一个地址，它既是钩子又是代币，合二为一。池子ID 0x594e8b83eb1ff6ffada65542d3881bd2aafbf89f28ccbeba1d8ab04dae97b1e4在区块25369082上定了位。你看那费率层级3000和tick间距60——对于波动尚未变成噪音的交易对来说，这是标准切法。但钩子合约与其中一个代币相同。这不是bug，这是声明：合约自己决定何时以及如何洗牌流动性。没人问过许可。V4池子不敲门——它们直接出现。而这个特定钩子的写法使得其逻辑与代币不可分割。如果有人想抽走流动性，他得跟自己的镜像对话。夜很静。内存池里没有警报。没人用闪电贷试探边界。只是有人摆好了牌，留在了桌上。也许是测试，也许是零和地址互换角色的第一手。盯着那个池子ID。它不喊叫。它在等别人先出招。

take.en: The hook is the token, the token is the hook — this pool is a closed loop, and the house is the mirror.
take.zh: 钩即是币，币即是钩——这个池子是个闭环，庄家就是自己的影子。

narrative.en: Four pools in an hour. Same pattern: zero fee, tick spacing 200, and three of them share the same hook contract: 0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc. Only the third pool breaks the mold with a different hook, 0x68c463f0c8ad1131eac043b035618223d3caeacc. But the structure is identical: WETH (zero address) paired with tokens ending in 1110 or 3000. Three tokens share the 1110 suffix: 0xcfa67a2fcbc6d3f373f0005daa765eb1cb5d1110, 0xda5e4d175f2dcb6009d80f81ee6efb68d9411110, 0xa2152be54519ccd7840a43736619ec78551d1110. The fourth token, 0x8adc1ae730f7632e8b809085409b8d89d7b63000, follows a different pattern with a different hook. Coincidence? Unlikely. Zero-fee pools with hooks in V4 aren't for retail trading—they're for mechanics. These pools are typically test beds, internal routing, or preparation for something larger. Three pools with the same hook suggest one developer or team deploying a series. The fourth might be a parallel branch or a different player with the same idea. Blocks come in a steady rhythm: 25361654, 25361695, 25362058, 25362196—gaps of 41, 363, and 138 blocks. Not a rush, but confident pacing. Someone is sitting calmly, clicking 'create.' Pool ID is a hash of tokens, fee, and hook. Same hook, different tokens, different pools. What they'll do is a question for the hook. V4 hooks can do anything: dynamic fees, TWAP oracles, MEV protection, even entry restrictions. But for now, it's a quiet deal on the felt.
narrative.zh: 一小时之内，四个池子。同样的模式：手续费为零，tickSpacing 为 200，其中三个池子用的是同一个 hook 合约：0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc。只有第三个池子不同，用的是另一个 hook：0x68c463f0c8ad1131eac043b035618223d3caeacc。但结构一致：WETH（零地址）对上后缀为 1110 或 3000 的代币。三个代币以 1110 结尾：0xcfa67a2fcbc6d3f373f0005daa765eb1cb5d1110、0xda5e4d175f2dcb6009d80f81ee6efb68d9411110、0xa2152be54519ccd7840a43736619ec78551d1110。第四个代币 0x8adc1ae730f7632e8b809085409b8d89d7b63000 则是另一种模式，hook 也不同。巧合？不太可能。V4 中零手续费的 hook 池不是给散户交易用的——它们是机制设计。这些池子通常是测试床、内部路由或为更大布局做准备。三个相同 hook 的池子暗示同一个开发者或团队在部署系列。第四个可能是平行分支或另一个玩家，但思路相同。区块间隔稳定：25361654、25361695、25362058、25362196——间隔分别为 41、363、138 个区块。不紧不慢，节奏从容。有人在冷静地点击“创建”。池子 ID 由代币、手续费和 hook 哈希而成。hook 相同，代币不同，池子就不同。它们会做什么，取决于 hook。V4 的 hook 无所不能：动态手续费、TWAP 预言机、MEV 防护、甚至准入限制。但目前，这只是江湖上的一次低调出手。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees—either zero or the maximum tier—instead of the usual market rates; this signals deliberate economic design, not an organic token launch.
take.zh: 建造者正在部署非标准手续费的池子——要么为零，要么为最高档——而非市场常规费率；这暗示着刻意的经济设计，而非自然的代币发行。
